description: Phase 9 localized n=5 direct-distribution stress campaign candidate on ibm_kingston. This tests whether the direct Grover-Rudolph workflow that succeeded for affine n=5 remains stable for a localized 32-cell probability law.
rationale: gr_beta_bump_n5 passed the Phase 9 backend-aware audit on ibm_kingston after layout and seed search.
The selected seed 67890 has predicted noisy TVD 0.032691 and maximum quantity-of-interest error 0.004585.
This campaign is a localized-profile stress test after the positive affine n=5 scaling result.
The campaign measures only the direct Grover-Rudolph distribution; amplified QAE remains deferred.
stopping_rules: Submit only after confirming the dry-run depth and two-qubit count match the Phase 9 layout audit.
Promote as a Phase 9 localized scaling result only if TVD stays below 0.05 and max cell deviation stays below 0.02.
Report quantity-specific errors separately; do not promote all functionals automatically from a passing distribution result.
Do not attach Grover amplification in this campaign.
